No. 3(vi)(c) of Notification No. 11/2017 - Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017 - Held, yes [Para 10]GST : Where applicant has been awarded a contract by Airport Authority of India for construction of residential colony for staff and employees, construction of residential colony by applicant attracts GST at rate of 12 per cent as per entry at Sl. No. 3(vi)(c) of Notification No. 11/2017 - Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017

Classification of services - Construction services (NR) - Applicant, a partnership firm of builders and developers is to undertake an affordable housing project on their land - It seeks advance ruling on what is rate of tax to be levied on sale of flats/units to prospective buyers - According to sub-item (da) of item (v) of Notification No. 1/2018 - Central Tax (Rate) 25-1-2018, low-cost houses up to a carpet area of 60 square metres per house is an affordable housing project which has been given infrastructure status vide notification of Government of India - Whether since project undertaken by applicant falls under definition of 'Affordable Housing project' concessional rate of taxes to be levied is 12 per cent (8 per cent GST after deducting value of land) - Held, yes [Para 5]GST: Rate of tax to be levied is 12 per cent (8 per cent GST after deducting value of land) in case of Affordable Housing Project  GST : Where concessional rate of tax of 12 per cent on affordable housing project is levied by GST Council, builder or developer having paid GST of 18 per cent or 28 per cent on inputs and capital goods used in construction of flats, will not be required to pay GST on construction service of flats, etc., as they would have enough ITC (input tax credits) in their books to pay output GST

Residential quarters construction - Construction Service - Heading No. 9954 - Concessional Rate - Appellant-assessee is engaged in civil execution contracts - It is awarded with a project by government entity NPCIL for carrying construction of quarters for residential usage of their employees engaged in nuclear power project - AAR ruled that execution of works contract service for construction of residential quarters for employees is not covered under Serial No. 3(vi) of Notification 11/2017-CT-Rate, dated 28-6-2017 and applicable rate of GST is 18 per cent as per Serial No. 3(xii) of Notification 11/2017-CT-Rate, dated 28-6-2017 - HELD: From a joint reading of MOA of NPCIL and relevant certificate, it is evident that works relating to construction of residential quarters are objectives incidental or ancillary to attainment of main object of NPCIL which is a government entity - However, vide amendment made to entry 3(vi) of Notification No. 11/2017-C.T.(Rate), dated 28-6-2017 vide Notification No. 15/2021-C.T.(Rate), dated 18-11-2021 effective from 1-1-2022, term 'Government entity' stands omitted in class of recipients from 1-1-2022 - Therefore, appellant-assessee is eligible for concessional rate of tax at 12 per cent as per entry 3(vi) of Notification No. 11/2017-C.T (Rate), dated 28-6-2017 (as amended) read with corresponding Notification Under TNGSTA for period up to 31-12-2021 and GST is applicable at 18 per cent from 31-12-2021 as per aforesaid amendment [Tamil Nadu Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017] [Paras 8.1 - 10] [Partly in favour of assessee]GST : Where execution of works contract service for construction of residential quarters by applicant-civil contractor is exclusively meant for use of employees of government entity NPCIL, and aforesaid construction is ancillary to attainment of main object of NPCIL, applicant is eligible for concessional rate of 12 per cent GST for period up to 31-12-2021

Residential quarters construction - Construction Service - Heading No. 9954 - Concessional Rate - Appellant-assessee is engaged in civil execution contracts - It is awarded with a project by government entity NPCIL for carrying construction of quarters for residential usage of their employees engaged in nuclear power project - AAR ruled that execution of works contract service for construction of residential quarters for employees is not covered under Serial No. 3(vi) of Notification 11/2017-CT-Rate, dated 28-6-2017 and applicable rate of GST is 18 per cent as per Serial No. 3(xii) of Notification 11/2017-CT-Rate, dated 28-6-2017 - HELD: From a joint reading of MOA of NPCIL and relevant certificate, it is evident that works relating to construction of residential quarters are objectives incidental or ancillary to attainment of main object of NPCIL which is a government entity - However, vide amendment made to entry 3(vi) of Notification No. 11/2017-C.T.(Rate), dated 28-6-2017 vide Notification No. 15/2021-C.T.(Rate), dated 18-11-2021 effective from 1-1-2022, term 'Government entity' stands omitted in class of recipients from 1-1-2022 - Therefore, appellant-assessee is eligible for concessional rate of tax at 12 per cent as per entry 3(vi) of Notification No. 11/2017-C.T (Rate), dated 28-6-2017 (as amended) read with corresponding Notification Under TNGSTA for period up to 31-12-2021 and GST is applicable at 18 per cent from 31-12-2021 as per aforesaid amendment [Tamil Nadu Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017] [Paras 8.1 - 10] [Partly in favour of assessee]   Circulars and Notifications : Entry 3(vi) and Serial No. 3(xii) of Notification No. 11/2017-C.T (Rate), dated 28-6-2017, Notification No. 15/2021-C.T (Rate), dated 18-11-2021 effective from 1-1-2022

Construction Service - Staff quarters of government entity - Heading No. 9954 - Classification - Whether supply of service of construction of staff quarters to be provided to government entity Uttar Pradesh Rajkiya Nirman Nigam Ltd., (UPRNN) is eligible for concessional rate of GST at 12 per cent in terms of S. No. 3 (vi) of Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate) - Applicant is required to construct staff quarters for Employee State Insurance Corporation (ESIC) under work order - HELD : Composite supply of works contract by way of construction of residential quarters meant for use of employees of ESIC can be considered as construction of civil structure or any other original works meant predominantly for use other than for commerce, industry or any other business or profession - UPRNN is a government entity - Such service is eligible for concessional rate when it is provided to Union territory or local authority and is not eligible for concessional rate if provided to government authority or government entity as per amendment made by Notification No. 15/2021-Central Tax (Rate) - Services to be provided by applicant are not covered under Sl. No. 3 (vi) of Notification No. 11/2017 to avail 12 per cent GST rate and same will be covered under residuary clause (xii) of Sl. No. 3 of Notification No. 11/2017 attracting 18 per cent GST [Maharashtra Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017] [Paras 5.2, 5.3.2 and 5.4.2] [In favour of revenue]GST : Supply of service of construction of staff quarters to be provided to a government entity is not entitled to concessional rate of 12% GST; such service attracts 18% GST

Works contract services - Government entity - Heading No. 9954 - Classification - State Police Housing and Infrastructure Corporation is a company of Government of Karnataka State incorporated under companies Act, 1956 and all shares are held by Government of Karnataka; hence, it qualifies to be considered as a government entity-Works contract services executed for construction of high security prison are liable to GST at 18 per cent with effect from 1-1-2022 as per entry No. 3(xii) of Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017, as amended vide Notification No. 22/2021-Central Tax (Rate), dated 31-12-2021 and Notification No. 03/2022-Central Tax (Rate), dated 13-7-2022 [Karnataka Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017] [Paras 10.1 and 14] [In favour of revenue] Works contract services - Government entity - Heading No. 9954 - Classification - Kudala Sangama Development Board was established under Kudala Sangama Development Board Act, 1994 - More than 90 per cent of members of board are from State Government and all administrative expenses of board are covered by grants given by State Government; hence, it qualifies to be considered as a Government Entity - Works contract services executed for construction of International Center and Museum are liable to GST at 18 per cent with effect from 1-1-2022 as per entry No. 3(xii) of Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017, as amended vide Notification No. 22/2021-Central Tax (Rate), dated 31-12-2021 and Notification No. 3/2022-Central Tax (Rate), dated 13-7-2022 [Karnataka Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017] [Paras 10.2 and 14] [In favour of revenue] Works contract services - Government entity - Heading No. 9954 - Classification - Karnataka Residential Educational Institutions Society (KRIES) is formed under societies Registration Act and Government of Karnataka may appoint persons to review progress of society and to hold inquiries into affairs of society and give directions; hence, qualifies to be considered as a Government Entity - Works contract services executed for Construction of Residential school complex are liable to GST at 18 per cent with effect from 1-1-2022 as per Entry No. 3(xii) of Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017, as amended vide Notification No. 22/2021-Central Tax (Rate), dated 31-12-2021 and Notification No. 03/2022 - Central Tax (Rate), dated : 13-7-2022 [Karnataka Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017] [Paras 10.3 and 14] [In favour of revenue] Works contract services - Government entity - Heading No. 9954 - Classification - Works of construction of Airport Terminal Buildings/facilities and associated works awarded by Public Works Department of Government of Karnataka, are work supplied to State Government – However, said works for construction of airport terminal building or airport are predominantly meant for commerce and, hence, are not covered under Entry 3(iii),(vi),(ix) and (x) of Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017 - Said works are covered under entry 3(xii) liable to 18 per cent tax [Karnataka Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017] [Paras 10.4 and 14] [In favour of revenue]   Circulars and Notifications : Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017; Notification No. 15/2021 - Central Tax (Rate), dated 18-11-2021; Notification No. 22/2021-Central Tax (Rate), dated 31-12-2021; and Notification No. 03/2022-Central Tax (Rate), dated 13-7-2022

Works contract services - Government entity - Heading No. 9954 - Classification - State Police Housing and Infrastructure Corporation is a company of Government of Karnataka State incorporated under companies Act, 1956 and all shares are held by Government of Karnataka; hence, it qualifies to be considered as a government entity-Works contract services executed for construction of high security prison are liable to GST at 18 per cent with effect from 1-1-2022 as per entry No. 3(xii) of Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017, as amended vide Notification No. 22/2021-Central Tax (Rate), dated 31-12-2021 and Notification No. 03/2022-Central Tax (Rate), dated 13-7-2022 [Karnataka Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017] [Paras 10.1 and 14] [In favour of revenue]GST : Works contract awarded by State Police Housing and Infrastructure Corporation for construction of High Security Prison is liable to 18 per cent GST  GST : Works contract awarded by area Development Board for construction of International Center and Museum is liable to 18 per cent GST  GST : Works contract awarded by Residential Educational Institutions Society for construction of residential school complex is liable to 18 per cent GST  GST : Where contract was awarded to applicant by public works department of State Government for construction of Airport Terminal Building, allied buildings/facilities and associated works and development of airport, it is liable to 18 per cent GST

Housing construction - Construction service - Works contract service for State Housing Board - Heading No. 9954 - Classification - Construction services are provided to Karnataka Housing Board with respect to construction of Police Station as a main contractor/sub-contractor - Karnataka Housing Board having been established under Karnataka Housing Board Act, 1962 and carrying out functions entrusted by State Government is to be considered as Government Entity as defined under Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017 as amended by Notification No. 31/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 13-10-2017 and liable to 18 per cent GST in terms of Sl. No. 3(xii) of Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017, as amended by Notification No. 3/2022-Central Tax (Rate), dated 13-7-2022 [Section 2(119) of Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017/Karnataka Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017] [Paras 13, 14 and 16 to 18]

Classification of services - Gujarat Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 (Construction services) - Heading No. 9954 (Construction services) - Applicant is engaged in development and construction of residential and commercial complex, called 'SAMANVAY RESIDENCY' - Development Authority has approved 'Samnvay Residency' under 'Affordable Housing Project' - Whether since project undertaken by applicant falls under definition of 'Affordable Housing', applicant's case is covered under reduced tax rate of 12 per cent GST - Held, yes [Paras 18-22]GST : Where applicant is engaged in development of residential project called 'SAMANVAY RESIDENCY', which falls under affordable housing project, construction services provided by applicant qualifies for reduced tax rate of 12 per cent GST as provided in Sl. No. 3 of Notification No. 11/2017-C.T. (Rate), dated 28-6-2017

Slum infrastructure - Construction service - Works contract service for State Slum Development Board - Heading No. 9954 - Classification - Construction of houses and infrastructure in slums for Karnataka Slum Development Board under Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana as a main contractor are liable to 12 per cent GST till 17-7-2022, in terms of Sl. No. 3(iv)(c) of Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017, as amended by Notification Nos. 20/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 22-8-2017 and 1/2018-Central Tax (Rate), dated 25-1-2018 and thereafter, such services are liable to 18 per cent GST in terms of Sl. No. 3(xii) of said Notification as amended by Notification No. 3/2022-Central Tax (Rate), dated 13-7-2022 - Such services when rendered as a sub-contractor, are not covered under Sl. No. 3(ix) and liable to 18 per cent GST in terms of Sl. No. 3(xii) of said Notification [Section 2(119) of Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017/Karnataka Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017] [Paras 10 to 12 and 16 to 18]GST : Construction of houses and infrastructure in slums for State Slum Development Board under Government Scheme as a main contractor is liable to 12 per cent GST till 17-7-2022 and thereafter, to 18 per cent GST; however, these services when provided by sub-contractor are also liable to 18 per cent GST  GST : Construction services provided to State Housing Board with respect to construction of Police Station as a main contractor/sub-contractor are liable to 18 per cent GST  GST : Construction services provided to a SPV of State Government and Municipal Corporation, for development of market under smart city project are liable to 18 per cent GST irrespective of whether such services are provided by main contractor or sub-contractor

Section 2(119) of the Central Goods And Services Tax Act, 2017 /Section 2(119) of the Kerala Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 - Works contract (NR) - Whether supply of works contract awarded by Government and supply of works contract awarded by Central University established under Central University Act will attract 12 per cent GST - Held, yes - Whether, however, supply of works contract awarded by a company for construction of Biotech lab and administrative block at Life Science Park will attract 18 per cent GST - Held, yes [Para 8]CGST/Kerala GST : Supply of works contract awarded by Government will attract 12 per cent GST rate

Slum infrastructure - Construction service - Works contract service for State Slum Development Board - Heading No. 9954 - Classification - Construction of houses and infrastructure in slums for Karnataka Slum Development Board under Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana as a main contractor are liable to 12 per cent GST till 17-7-2022, in terms of Sl. No. 3(iv)(c) of Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017, as amended by Notification Nos. 20/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 22-8-2017 and 1/2018-Central Tax (Rate), dated 25-1-2018 and thereafter, such services are liable to 18 per cent GST in terms of Sl. No. 3(xii) of said Notification as amended by Notification No. 3/2022-Central Tax (Rate), dated 13-7-2022 - Such services when rendered as a sub-contractor, are not covered under Sl. No. 3(ix) and liable to 18 per cent GST in terms of Sl. No. 3(xii) of said Notification [Section 2(119) of Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017/Karnataka Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017] [Paras 10 to 12 and 16 to 18]  Housing construction - Construction service - Works contract service for State Housing Board - Heading No. 9954 - Classification - Construction services are provided to Karnataka Housing Board with respect to construction of Police Station as a main contractor/sub-contractor - Karnataka Housing Board having been established under Karnataka Housing Board Act, 1962 and carrying out functions entrusted by State Government is to be considered as Government Entity as defined under Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017 as amended by Notification No. 31/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 13-10-2017 and liable to 18 per cent GST in terms of Sl. No. 3(xii) of Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017, as amended by Notification No. 3/2022-Central Tax (Rate), dated 13-7-2022 [Section 2(119) of Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017/Karnataka Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017] [Paras 13, 14 and 16 to 18]  Market construction - Construction service - Works contract service for Government SPV - Heading No. 9954 - Classification - Construction services are provided to Belagavi Smart City Limited, a Special Purpose Vehicle company incorporated by Government of Karnataka and Belagavi City Corporation on 50:50 shareholding basis, as a main contractor/sub-contractor for development of modern market under a smart city project - Said company neither being a Governmental Authority nor a Government Entity as defined under Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017, as amended by Notification No. 31/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 13-10-2017, construction services provided to it with respect to development of modern market is liable to 18 per cent GST in terms of Sl. No. 3(xii) of Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017 as amended by Notification No. 3/2022-Central Tax (Rate), dated 13-7-2022 irrespective of whether such services provided as a main contractor or sub-contractor [Section 2(119) of Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017/Karnataka Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017] [Paras 15 to 18]   Circulars and Notifications : Notification No. 20/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 22-8-2017; Notification No. 1/2018-Central Tax (Rate), dated 25-1-2018; Notification No. 15/2021-Central Tax (Rate), dated 18-11-2021; Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017; Notification No. 3/2022-Central Tax (Rate), dated 13-7-2022 and Notification No. 31/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 13-10-2017

Works contract services - Government entity - Heading No. 9954 - Classification - Works of construction of Airport Terminal Buildings/facilities and associated works awarded by Public Works Department of Government of Karnataka, are work supplied to State Government – However, said works for construction of airport terminal building or airport are predominantly meant for commerce and, hence, are not covered under Entry 3(iii),(vi),(ix) and (x) of Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017 - Said works are covered under entry 3(xii) liable to 18 per cent tax [Karnataka Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017] [Paras 10.4 and 14] [In favour of revenue]

Classification of services - Maharashtra Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 - Civil construction services - Heading No. 9954 (Construction services) - Applicant-company is engaged in business of civil construction of residential premises as a contractor - It seeks advance ruling on issue as to whether construction services proposed to be provided by applicant will qualify for reduced GST rate of 12 per cent as provided in Sr. No. 3, item (v)(c) of Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017 as amended by Notification No. 1/2018-Central tax (Rate), dated 25-1-2018 - Low cost houses in an affordable housing project having area of 60 sq. mts. or upto 60 sq. mts. will attract 12 per cent GST - Whether since project undertaken by applicant is an affordable housing project, it will attract rate of 12 per cent GST under Sr. No. 3 of said Notification – Held, yes [Para 5.8][In favour of assessee]GST: Where applicant undertook project of construction of residential flat (Low cost flats) having carpet area of upto or less than 60 sq. mts. and its project falls under definition of 'Affordable Housing Project', applicant's case is covered under concessional tax rate slab of 12 per cent

Classification of services - Maharashtra Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 - Housing Project construction -  Heading 9954 - [Construction services] - Applicant has entered into civil construction contract with 'J' Ltd. in respect of seven residential buildings - Whether since project undertaken by applicant falls under definition of 'Affordable Housing Project' (carpet area being less than 60 sq. Mts.) applicant's case is covered under concessional tax rate of 12 per cent under Heading No. 9954 (Construction services) in terms of item (v)(da) of Sr. No. 3 of Notification No. 11/2017, Central Tax (Rate) dated 28-6-2017 - Held, yes - Whether, therefore, benefit of reduced rate would be available to applicant in cases of supply effected after 25-1-2018, i.e. date on which Notification 1/2018-Central Tax (Rate) was issued for those flats having carpet area upto 60 sq. mtrs. - Held, yes - Whether, however, in case of other flats which have carpet area more than 60 sq. mtrs. or which are commercial units, applicant would be required to pay GST at normal applicable rate - Held, yes - Whether building completion and finishing services will not be regarded as a separate services; such building completion and finishing services will be a part of composite supply of works contract services with principal supply of building construction - Held,yes - Whether 'housing project' cannot be confined only to dwelling units, it would also include within its fold, other common amenities, structures, etc. and, thus, rate applicable to principal supply will also be applicable to common amenities - Held, yes - Whether rate of GST will be 18% on works contract services provided for construction of units, common areas and amenities which do not qualify criteria of low cost houses - Held, yes [Paras 5.11, and 5.14.2][In favour of assessee]GST : Where applicant constructs residential complex under contract and project undertaken by it falls under definition of ‘affordable housing project’ (carpet area being less than 60 sq. Mts.), applicant’s case is covered under Heading No. 9954 eligible for concessional tax rate of 12 per cent; in case of other flats which have carpet area more than 60 sq. mtrs. or which are commercial units, applicant would be required to pay GST at normal applicable rate

Residential apartment construction - Construction services - Heading No. 9954 - Concessional Rate - Applicant-real estate developer has purchased land in its name and has obtained building permit - It has entered into two agreements with customers; one for sale of undivided share of land and another for construction of apartment - GST is not collected on amount collected for undivided share of land but same was collected for apartment construction at rate of 18 per cent - Applicant's project is satisfying all conditions of definition of 'ongoing project' as occurring in clause (xx) of Para 4 of Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017 as amended by Notification No. 3/2019-Central Tax (Rate), dated 29-3-2019 - Applicant is eligible and has exercised its option for continuing with payment of tax at old rates in respect of ongoing projects - Project is not covered under any of schemes specified under Item (ie) of Sl. No. 3 of said notification - Therefore, applicant is not eligible for concessional rate of tax at 12 per cent - Applicant is liable to pay GST at rate of 18 per cent in respect of services of construction of residential apartments supplied by it [Kerala Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017] [Paras 7.10] [In favour of revenue]GST : Applicant-real estate developer having exercised its option for continuing with payment of tax at old rates in respect to its ongoing project of construction of residential apartments should pay GST at rate of 18 per cent; since project is not covered under any of schemes specified under Item (ie) of Sl. No. 3 of Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate), applicant is not eligible for concessional rate of tax of 12 per cent  GST : Where applicant is providing construction of residential apartment services alongwith sale of an undivided share of land in arriving at taxable value of supply, applicant will be eligible to avail deduction of one-third of total amount (being deemed value of undivided share of land) charged for supply   GST : Provisions of section 13 of CGST, 2017 will apply to determination of time of supply of construction of residential apartments services

Classification of services - Construction services (NR) - Applicant is engaged in business of construction of residential and commercial complex - Applicant is undertaking development of residential apartments under a project called 'Prajapati Magnum' - Whether since project undertaken by applicant falls under definition of 'Affordable Housing', applicant's case is covered under tax rate of 12 per cent, under Heading 9954 (Construction Services) of Notification No. 11/2017 but benefit of reduced rate would be available to them only in cases of supply effected after 25-1-2018, i.e., date on which Notification 1/2018-Central Tax (Rate) was issued and benefit of this reduced rate would be applicable in case of only those flats which are of carpet area upto 60 sq. mtrs. - Held, yes [Paras 5 and 6]CGST: Where project 'Prajapati Magnum' undertaken by applicants falls under definition of Affordable Housing, GST at rate of 12 per cent will be leviable on construction of low cost houses with carpet area upto 60 sq. m.

Construction service - Tax liability - Rate - Sale of semi-finished structure and supply of completion of semi-finished structure - HELD: Agreements entered with prospective buyers separately for sale of semi-finished structure and supply of service of completion of semi-finished structure by way of providing construction service will be considered as non-severable agreement or single contract - GST at rate of 1 per cent and 5 per cent will be levied on affordable housing and other housing respectively without ITC - If contract is severable from initial agreement, then GST at rate of 18 per cent will be levied for such construction service [Section 9 of Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017/Telangana Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017] [Para 7] [In favour of assessee]

Works contract service - Construction of employee quarters - Heading No. 9954 - Classification - Whether execution of works contract service for construction of residential quarters for employees of Kudankulam Nuclear Power Project (KKNPP) which is unit of Nuclear Power Corporation India Limited (NPCIL) would be taxable at 12 per cent - HELD : Works contract service is provided as is evident from contract - NPCIL qualifies as government entity as it has been established under Department of Atomic Energy with 100 per cent equity held by Central Government - Work entrusted to NPCIL is to implement atomic power projects for generation of electricity - Construction of residential quarters for KKNPP cannot be construed as work in relation to work entrusted to NPCIL by Central Government in absence of any document providing for same - Impugned works contract service is not covered under entry at Sl. No. 3(vi) of Notification No. 11/2017-CT(R) and concessional rate of 12 per cent is not available - GST is payable at 18 per cent in terms of entry at Sl. No. 3(xii) of Notification No. 11/2017-CT(R) - Concessional rate of 12 per cent will not be available even if service rendered is in relation to work entrusted by government entity as said term was omitted from 1-1-2022 [Section 2(119) of Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017/Tamil Nadu Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017] [Paras 7.3, 7.4, 7.5, 8 and 10] [In favour of revenue]GST : Concessional rate of 12 per cent GST is not available to works contract service rendered to government entity when same is not in relation to work entrusted by government till 31-12-2021 and even otherwise after 1-1-2022 such activity is liable to GST of 18 per cent  GST : Advance ruling cannot be sought on questions that are purely procedural in nature

Anti-profiteering measures - Charging higher rate of GST - Affordable Housing Scheme - Respondent-assessee providing construction services under Affordable Housing Scheme had charged GST at rate of 12 per cent instead of 8 per cent from flat buyers/applicant-complainant as reduced by Notification No. 1/2018-Central Tax(Rate), dated 25-1-2018 which amended Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax(Rate), dated 28-6-2017 - Applicable tax on construction services during pre-GST period was 4.5 per cent (Service Tax at rate of 4.5 per cent) which was enhanced to 8 per cent in GST regime by virtue of Notifications ibid. - There being no rate reduction after coming into force GST with effect from 1-7-2017, charging of GST at wrong rate/enhanced rate from flat buyers/applicant-complainant did not fall under scope of profiteering under section 171 of Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 - Matter was to be referred jurisdictional authorities for necessary action under Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 [Section 171 of Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017/Madhya Pradesh Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 - Rule 129 of Central Goods and Services Tax Rules, 2017/Madhya Pradesh Goods and Services Tax Rules, 2017] [Paras 2(xxix), 2(xxx) and 21]

Construction of Commercial apartments - Tax Liabilityon supply of construction of a complex, building civil structure or a part thereof, including, commercial apartments -Applicant is engaged in supplying services of construction, erection, commissioning, installation, completion, fitting out, repair, maintenance, renovation or alteration of affordable and other than affordable residential apartments, non-affordable housing and commercial apartments under Real Estate project (REP) - Applicant seeks advance ruling on applicable GST Rate on supply of construction of a complex, building civil structure or a part thereof, including, commercial apartments (shops, offices, godowns etc) by a promoter in a REP other than RREP - Held:In instant case, it is clear that services provided by taxpayer clearly falls under notification No. 03/2019- CT (rate) dated 29.03.2019 - Therefore , applicant is liable to pay GST at rate of 18% [9% - CGST + 9% - SGST] in respect of services of construction of complex, building, civil structure or a part including commercial apartments (shops, offices, godowns etc.) as per entry at Item No. (if) of Notification No. 03/2019-Central Tax (Rate), dated 29.03.2019, subject to conditions prescribed under said entry. [Section 9 of Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017/Rajasthan Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017][Para 11][In favour of assessee]

Classification of services - Madhya Pradesh Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 - Construction services - Heading No. 9954 - Applicant-company is engaged in carrying out works contract in relation to construction of road, bridges, buildings, and civil structures - A company (MPPGCL) owned by Government of Madhya Pradesh, floated a tender, for construction of some flats - Applicant raised bill for work completed at rate of 18 per cent GST to MPPGCL - However, MPPGCL is of opinion that in work under reference, applicable rate of GST should be 12 per cent by treating itself as a Government entity - Whether since Government of Madhya Pradesh has a 100 per cent shareholding in MPPGCL and is also exercising full control over activities of said company, MPPGCL qualifies to be called and termed as a 'Government Entity' for purpose of GST - Held, yes - Whether since construction activity does not have any relation to principal work of power generation entrusted by State Government to MPPGCL, works contract service of construction of residential quarters would attract GST at rate of 18 per cent (9 per cent CGST + 9 per cent SGST) in terms of Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017 and Notification No. 11/2017-Madhya Pradesh Tax (Rate) dated 28-6-2017 - Held, yes [para 5] [In favour of respondent]GST: Where activity of construction of flats allotted by MPPGCL to applicant does not have any relation to principal work of power generation entrusted by State Government to MPPCGL, work contract service of construction of residential quarters would attract GST at rate of 18 per cent (9 per cent CGST + 9 per cent SGST)

Construction service - Composite supply of Works contracts - Heading No. 9954 - Concessional rate - Applicant is awarded construction services contract by Andhra Pradesh Industrial Infrastructure Corporation Ltd (APIIC) deriving its sustenance from sale of sheds, land, houses on outright sale or hire purchase - 100% of APIIC shares held by Andhra Pradesh Government and its nominees - HELD: APIIC is 'Government Entity' for GST matters as defined in para 4 of clauses (ix) and (x) of Notification No. 11/2017-CT (Rate), dated 28-6-2017 as amended by  Notification No. 31/2017-CT (Rate) dated 13-10-2017 - However, APIIC runs on business model as it would pass on costs in its transactions to end client, and its activities and modus operandi are basically business and not otherwise - As construction is for APIIC's use to conduct its essentially business oriented activities, applicant's contract is not eligible for concessional rate of 12% under SI.No.3 (vi) of Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017 - Applicant's contract is classifiable under SAC heading No. 9954 under Construction Services, with entry Sr. No. 3(ii) of Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017 i.e., Composite Supply of works contract as defined in section 2 (119) of CGST Act, 2017 and applicant is liable to 18 per cent rate of tax [Section 2(9) of Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017/Andhra Pradesh Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017] [Para 7] [In favour of revenue]GST : Andhra Pradesh Industrial Infrastructure Corporation Ltd (APIIC), whose 100% shares are held by Andhra Pradesh Government, is 'Government Entity' for GST matters; however, APIIC's activities being essentially business oriented and it passes its transaction costs to its end clients, applicant who is awarded construction contract by APIIC is not eligible for 12% concessional rate; it will be liable to 18% GST

It launched an Affordable Housing Project (Affordable Group Housing Colony) in Gurugram on 1-12-2015 under scheme approved by Government of Haryana (Affordable Housing Policy, 2013) and started construction of flats over land measuring 5 acres before 31-3-2019 - It started construction of flats over land measuring 4 acres after 1-4-2019 - Whether project over said land is an ongoing project as construction was started before 31-3-2019 and, therefore, rate of tax applicable in respect of flats over said land is 12 per cent (with input tax credit + land abatement) in view of Notification No. 20/2017 - RBF shed construction - Construction services - Heading No. 9954 - Concessional rate - Construction services is being provided by applicant to Andhra Pradesh Industrial Infrastructure Corporation Ltd. (APIIC) - APIIC is getting revenue from operations like sale of land, houses, interest on hire purchase, long-term borrowings etc. - In APIIC, Andhra Pradesh Government and its nominees have 100 per cent shareholding, hence, it is "Government entity" as defined in para 4 of clauses (ix) and (x) of Notification No. 11/2017-CT (Rate), dated 28-6-2017 - APIIC derives its sustenance from sale of sheds, land, houses on outright sale or hire purchase etc. - APIIC runs on business model as it would pass costs in its transactions to end client - APIIC's activities are essentially business oriented - Hence, construction services provided by applicant to APIIC are not eligible for concessional rate of 12 per cent available under Notification No. 24/2017-CT (Rate), dated 21-9-2017 - Applicant's contract with APIIC is classifiable under Heading No. 9954 under construction services, with Entry No. (ii) of Sr. No. 3 of Notification No. 11/2017 Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017 i.e., Composite Supply of Works Contract as defined in section 2(119) of CGST Act 2017 and APGST Act, 2017, and liable to 18 per cent (9 per cent CGST and 9 per cent SGST) [Section 2(119) of Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017/Andhra Pradesh Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017] [Para 7] [In favour of revenue]GST : Even though APIIC is a Government entity, since its activities are essentially business oriented, RBF shed construction services as provided by applicant to APIIC are not eligible for concessional rate of 12 per cent GST; applicant's service would be classifiable under heading No. 9954; it is Composite Supply of Works Contract liable to 18 per cent GST

Hotel -cum-shopping and multiplex construction - Construction Services - Heading No. 9954 - Classification - Applicant intends to get a land from WBHIDCO on 99 years lease for purpose of setting up of hotel-cum-shopping and multiplex which includes permission to construct certain area as residential flats - HELD: Applicable SAC Code on this supply is 9954 as Construction Services) and applicable tax rate on supply under consideration shall be 18% - Applicant is eligible for a deduction as attributable to land portion i.e. 1/3 of consideration on total value of supply for purpose of payment of applicable tax - GST is to be paid on construction work for prospective clients, regardless of whether a lump sum or periodic payments, is charged [Section  9 of Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017/ West Bengal Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017] [Para 3.9, 3.10, 3.11 and 3.12] [In favour of Revenue] Hotel -cum-shopping and multiplex - No. 12 of Notification No. 12/2017-Central Tax (Rate) dated June 28, 2017 does not arise [Section  11 of Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017/ West Bengal Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017] [Para 3.12] [In favour of Revenue] Hotel - Membership Organization Services - Heading No. 9995 - Classification - Applicant intends to get a land from WBHIDCO on 99 years lease for purpose of setting up of hotel-cum-shopping and multiplex which includes permission to construct certain area as residential flats - According to Draft Lease Deed as per tender, lessee is not permitted to sub-lease land or part thereof - However, applicant, being lessee, will be permitted to sub-lease/ assign right on constructed area - It is obvious that ownership of land remains with WBHIDCO - Applicant may sub-lease/assign rights of constructed area in following two models (a) one-time lump sum payment (may be payable in installments till completion and granting possession and registry in favour of prospective clients) for constructed units, (b) against periodic payments for use constructed area, during term of agreement, without any registry with Registrar and on expiry constructed area shall be repossessed by lessee i.e. applicant - Besides above arrangement, prospective customers may also be required to pay monthly/annual maintenance charges either directly toapplicant or to some society made for same - HELD: GST is payable on monthly/annual maintenance charges as per entry in sl. no. 33 of Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate) dated June 28, 2017 - SAC Code in this case would be 9995 and the applicable GST rate is 18% [Section  9 of Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017/ West Bengal Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017] [Para 3.12] [In favour of revenue]   Circulars and Notifications: Notification No. 11/2017 dated 28-6-2017, Notification No. 12/2017-Central Tax (Rate) dated June 28, 2017

Classification of services - Karnataka Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 - Works contract - Heading No. 9954 [Construction Services] - Applicant a Private Limited Company entered into a works contract agreement with National Centre for Biological Sciences(NCBS) for construction of Hostel building at NCBS Campus in Bangalore - It sought advance ruling on whether it should charge GST at rate of 12 per cent for service provided to NCBS as per Notification No 24/2017 Central Tax (Rate) dated 21-9-2017- It is found that NCBS, which is a separate centre of Tata Institute of Fundamental Research (TIFR), receives grant from Department of Atomic Energy, Government of India and that NCBS is neither set-up by an Act of Parliament or State Legislature nor was established by any Government, but is an autonomous body under aegis of TIFR - Moreover, council administering this institute has only 4 members appointed by Government and therefore Government does not have more than 90 per cent control over it - Thus, NCBS is not covered under definition of a 'Government Entity' as per clause (x) of para 4 of Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax(Rate) dated 28-6-2017 - Furthermore, Institute is not established to carry out a function entrusted by Government, thus, it is not covered by clause (vi) of serial no. 3 of Notification - Whether therefore, service supplied by applicant to NCBS is not taxable at concessional rate of 12 per cent and is taxable at 18 per cent under residual item no. (xii) of Serial No. 3 of Notification No. 11/2017- Central Tax (Rate) dated 28-6-2017 - Held, yes [Paras 5 and 6]GST: Works contract service provided by applicant to National Centre for Biological Sciences (NCBS) for construction of hostel building on campus is taxable at 18 per cent GST under residual item no. (xii) of Serial No. 3 of Notification No. 11/2017- Central Tax (Rate) dated 28-6-2017

Emoluments paid to staff - Other employment and labour supply services nowhere else classified - Heading No. 998519 - Classification - Tax Liability - Applicant is authority created under Airports Authority of India Act, 1994 - Applicant entered into a concessionaire agreement with Adani Thiruvananthapuram International Airport Limited - Applicant seeks advance ruling on whether GST is leviable on invoice raised by applicant staff cost salary/of reimbursement Thiruvananthapuram International Airport Limited? If yes, at what rate? - Held: From clause 6.5.5 of agreement, impugned amount represents 'emoluments' payable by applicant to select employees, i.e., employees of applicant working for concessionaire - In this regard, employees of applicant are supplied to concessionaire for a consideration, in pursuant to agreement - Hence, this service falls under 'Other employment and labour supply services nowhere else classified' viz. HSN 998519 - Applicable tax rate for this SAC is 9 per cent each towards CGST and SGST as applicable vide Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017. [Section 9 of Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017/Kerala State Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017] [Para 8] [Against assessee]

Residential apartment construction - Construction services - Heading No. 9954 - Concessional Rate - Applicant-real estate developer has purchased land in its name and has obtained building permit - It has entered into two agreements with customers; one for sale of undivided share of land and another for construction of apartment - GST is not collected on amount collected for undivided share of land but same was collected for apartment construction at rate of 18 per cent - Applicant's project is satisfying all conditions of definition of 'ongoing project' as occurring in clause (xx) of Para 4 of Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017 as amended by Notification No. 3/2019-Central Tax (Rate), dated 29-3-2019 - Applicant is eligible and has exercised its option for continuing with payment of tax at old rates in respect of ongoing projects - Project is not covered under any of schemes specified under Item (ie) of Sl. No. 3 of said notification - Therefore, applicant is not eligible for concessional rate of tax at 12 per cent - Applicant is liable to pay GST at rate of 18 per cent in respect of services of construction of residential apartments supplied by it [Kerala Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017] [Paras 7.10] [In favour of revenue]  Valuation - Residential apartments - Applicant-real estate developer being service provider entered into two agreements with customers; one for sale of an undivided share of land and another for construction of apartment - In terms of paragraph 2 of Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017, value of land or undivided share of land should be deemed to be one-third of total amount charged for supply irrespective of actual value of land - Accordingly, applicant is eligible to avail deduction of one-third of total amount charged for supply in arriving at taxable value of supply [Section 15 of Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017/Kerala Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017] [Para 7.11.2 ] [In favour of assessee]  Construction of residential apartments - Time of supply - Provisions of section 13 of Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 will apply to determination of time of supply [Section 13 of Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017] [Paras 7.11.2]   Circulars and Notifications : Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017, Notification No. 3/2019-Central Tax (Rate), dated 29-3-2019 and Notification No. 6/2019-Central Tax (Rate), dated 29-3-2019

Construction service - Affordable residential apartment - Heading No. 9954 - Concessional rate - Residential Real Estate Project (RREP) comprised of both affordable and other than affordable residential apartments - HELD : Project undertaken is covered under definition of 'real estate project' and applicant falls within definition of a 'promoter' - Construction of affordable residential apartments is covered under services specified in entry at Sl. No. 3(i) and (ia) of Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate) - GST is payable at 1.5 per cent in respect of service of construction of affordable residential apartments and at 7.5 per cent in respect of service of construction of residential apartments other than affordable residential apartments [Kerala State Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017] [Paras 7.7 and 7.8] [In favour of assessee]   Circulars  Notifications : Notification No. 3/2019-Central Tax (Rate), dated 29-3-2019 and Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017

I. Section 2(119) of the Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017/Section 2(119) of the Karnataka Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 - Works contract - Applicant entered into a contract with developer for construction of residential apartment - Whether since contract is for construction of an immovable property, same is covered under works contract as per section 2(119) - Held, yes [Para 12]GST : If projects are affordable housing projects and are given infrastructure status as per notification of Government of India, construction service provided by applicant to developer under residential project is liable to tax at rate of 6 per cent CGST and 6 per cent KGST as provided in Sl. No. 3(v)(da) of Notification No. 11/2017 - Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017; else, services will be liable to tax at rate of 9 per cent under CGST Act and at rate of 9 per cent under KGST Act as provided in Sl. No. 3(xii) of Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017  GST : Where applicant, engaged in business of civil works contract entered into an agreement with developer for construction of residential apartment project, since contract is for construction of an immovable property, same is covered under works contract as per section 2(119)

Classification of services - Kerala State Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 - Construction services - Heading No. 9954 [Construction services] - Section 2(119) of the Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017/Section 2(119) of the Kerala State Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 - Works contract - A charitable organisation 'S' engaged in various charitable activities across Kerala has awarded a rehabilitation project to applicant for providing affordable shelter to 2018 flood victims - Applicant constructed 45 residential units in different locations on land belonging to flood victims identified by Trust - Whether activity undertaken by applicant cannot be construed as construction of affordable residential apartments by a promoter in a residential real estate project intended for sale to a buyer and, hence, rate of GST prescribed under Sl. No. 3(i) of Notification No. 11/2017 Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017, is not applicable in respect of said activity - Held, yes - Whether activity undertaken by applicant is construction of 45 individual residential houses at different locations on land belonging to individual beneficiaries and activity squarely falls within scope of works contract as defined in section 2(119) - Held, yes - Whether services provided by applicant to 'S' for construction of low cost housing units falls within ambit of Sl. No. 3(v) of Notification No. 11/2017 - Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017 and is liable to GST at rate of 12 per cent - Held, yes [Paras 11 and 15]GST : Where applicant constructed residential units on land belonging to flood victims under a rehabilitation project awarded to it by a charitable trust, activity squarely falls within scope of works contract under section 2(119) and is liable to GST at rate of 12 per cent as per Sl. No. 3(v) of Notification No. 11/2017 - Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017

Construction Service - Rate of GST - Advance ruling is sought on question as to whether GST is to be charged at rate of 1.5% or at rate of 7.5% from customers for sale of flats - HELD: Project in present case commenced after 1-4-2019 - Registration was not taken as any affordable housing scheme of government - Affordable Housing Scheme as notified is applicable to projects that were on-going as on 1-4-2019 - Effective scheme is not applicable to present project as commencement is after said date - As instant project is satisfying criteria of affordable residential apartment as per Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate), GST is payable at 1.5 per cent for sale of flats, except where entire consideration is received after issuance of completion certificate or after its first occupation, as reduced by 1/3rd to factor value of land [Para 4.18] [In favour of revenue]

Works contract service - Government entity - Heading No. 9954 - Concessional rate of tax - Applicant is engaged in providing works contract service to Andhra Pradesh Industrial Infrastructure Corporation Ltd. (APIIC) - HELD: APIIC qualifies as a 'Government entity' as Government of Andhra Pradesh including its nominees have 100 per cent of shareholding and same is evident from shareholding ratios mentioned in Annual Report - APIIC is engaged in business activities as construction work undertaken is meant for use by Ministry of Industries which is essentially meant for promotion of business and industry - Concessional rate of GST at 12 per cent is not available - Services provided to APIIC are in nature of composite supply of works contract service, classifiable under SAC 9954 and GST is payable at 18 per cent on same in terms of entry at SL. No. 3(ii) of Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate) [Andhra Pradesh Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017] [In favour of revenue]GST : Construction service provided to APIIC is not eligible for GST at 12 per cent as APIIC, although qualifies as Government entity, is engaged in promotion of business and industry; GST is payable at 18 per cent on supply of services to APIIC

Construction Service - Hospital of government entity - Heading 9954 - Classification - Whether service of construction of 200 bedded hospital to be provided to Uttar Pradesh Rajkiya Nirman Nigam Ltd., (UPRNN) is eligible for concessional rate of GST at 12% in terms of S. No. 3 (vi) of Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate) - Applicant is required to construct entire hospital for Employee State Insurance Corporation (ESIC) - Composite supply of works contract by way of construction of a hospital i.e., clinical establishment is provided to government entity - HELD : Service is eligible for concessional rate when they are provided to Union territory or local authority and is not eligible for concessional rate if provided to governmental authority or government entity as per amendment to Notification No. 11/2017 by Notification No. 15/2021 - Service to be provided is not covered under said entry of Notification No. 11/2017 providing for 12% GST rate and same will be covered under residuary clause (xii) of Sl. No. 3 of Notification No. 11/2017 attracting 18% GST [Maharashtra Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017] [Paras 5.2, 5.3.2, 5.3.3, 5.3.5, 5.4.1 and 5.4.2] [In favour of revenue]GST : Service of construction of hospital to be provided to a government entity is not covered under amended entry pertaining to concessional rate of 12% GST; such service attracts 18% GST

Residential house - Construction service - GST rate - Petitioner-allottee contended that 8 per cent GST rate specified by respondent-U.P. Avas Evam Vikas Parishad was contrary to instructions issued by Ministry of Finance - Only dispute between parties was whether respondent State Avas Evam Vikas Parishad was entitled to charge GST at rate of 1 per cent or 8 per cent - Reference had been made to certain internal communications between authorities of respondent, rate of tax was to be charged as per notification issued under GST Act, 2017 - Therefore, said issue could not be adjudicated at preliminary stage, that too when dispute was brought by allottee against U.P. Avas Evam Vikas Parishad - Respondent development authority was directed to ascertain correct GST rate from appropriate GST authority and communicate same to petitioners within three months [Section 9 of Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017/Uttar Pradesh Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017] [Paras 3 and 4]   Circulars and Notifications : Instruction issued by Government of India, Ministry of Finance, dated 7-5-2019

Pure labour service - Construction service - Heading No. 9954 - Classification - Applicant entered into an agreement with M/s B.C.M. Builders LLP to provide pure labour construction services - M/s B.C.M. Builders LLP has entered into a contract with Rajasthan Government to construct 380 flats under 'Affordable Housing Scheme under Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana' (including material and labour) - M/s B.C.M. Builders LLP has further sublet work to applicant - HELD : As per Entry No. 10 of Notification No. 12/2017-Central Tax (Rate), following main requirements to get the benefit of the above notification - (a) Services provided by way of pure labour contracts and (b) Applicable only to the beneficiary-led individual house construction or enhancement under the Housing for All (Urban) Mission or Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - As applicant is under obligation to provide machine and other material besides labour supply, agreement between applicant and M/s B.C.M. Builders LLP is not a pure labour contract service supplied for construction of 380 flats under Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Further, benefit of relevant entry of Notification No. 12/2017-Central Tax (Rate) dated 28-6-2017 is applicable only to beneficiary-led individual house construction or enhancement under Housing for All (Urban) Mission or Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Applicant could not establish that they are working for Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Therefore, service provided by applicant for construction of flats is not covered under Entry No. 10 of Notification No. 12/2017-Central Tax (Rate) dated 28-6-2017 (as amended) - Construction service provided by applicant falls under HSN code 9954 attracting GST at rate of 18 per cent [Section  9 of Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017/ Rajasthan Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017] [Paras 8 to 11] [In favour of revenue]

Works contract services - Government entity - Heading No. 9954 - Classification - Kudala Sangama Development Board was established under Kudala Sangama Development Board Act, 1994 - More than 90 per cent of members of board are from State Government and all administrative expenses of board are covered by grants given by State Government; hence, it qualifies to be considered as a Government Entity - Works contract services executed for construction of International Center and Museum are liable to GST at 18 per cent with effect from 1-1-2022 as per entry No. 3(xii) of Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017, as amended vide Notification No. 22/2021-Central Tax (Rate), dated 31-12-2021 and Notification No. 3/2022-Central Tax (Rate), dated 13-7-2022 [Karnataka Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017] [Paras 10.2 and 14] [In favour of revenue]

facts.text:
The applicant-company (MPPGCL) is engaged in carrying out the works contract in relation to construction of road, bridges, buildings, civil structures of Government, semi-Government and private undertakings.

The applicant was awarded a contract for construction of 599 flats by MPPGCL.

During the course of carrying out the construction work, the applicant company raised Running Bills (RA bills) for the portion of work completed at a point of time to MPPGCL by charging CGST and SGST at the rate of 9 per cent each, in view of Notification No. 11/2017 Central Tax (Rate) dated 28-6-2017.

MPPGCL is of the opinion that in the work under reference, the applicable rate of GST should be 12 per cent (6+6), as per Notification No.11/2017 Central Tax (Rate) dated 28-6-2017, by treating itself as a Government entity and the work allocated to the service provider is the work which is the work supplied to it by the Government.

The applicant seeks advance ruling on issue as to whether MPPGCL is a 'Government Entity' and whether the work contract service of construction of 599 residential quarters allotted to the applicant company, will be charged under the GST rate of 12 per cent (6+6) or 18 per cent (9+9).

The applicant has entered into civil construction contract with 'J' Ltd. in respect of seven residential buildings.

The applicant seeks advance ruling on question as to whether the construction services proposed to be provided by the applicant under the subject project will qualify for the reduced GST rate of 12 per cent (6 per cent each of CGST & SGST), as provided in Sl. No. 3, item (v), sub-item (da) of Notification No. 1/2018-Central Tax (Rate), dated 25-1-2018.

The applicant-company is engaged in the business of civil construction of residential premises as a contractor. It had filed the instant application in respect of a proposed civil construction contract to be entered into with a developer for construction of a residential project comprising of 135 buildings all having residential flats/units having carpet area of up to or less than 60 Sq. Mts. According to them, since more than 50 per cent of PSI is utilized towards construction of LCH, the project would qualify as an 'Affordable Housing Project' (AHP).

It seeks advance ruling on the issue as to whether the construction services proposed to be provided by the applicant will qualify for the reduced CGST rate of 12 per cent (6 per cent each of CGST & SGST), as provided in Sr. No. 3, item (v)(c) of Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017 as amended by Notification No. 1/2018-Central Tax (Rate), dated 25-1-2018.

The applicant is engaged in development of commercial properties.

It launched an Affordable Housing Project [Affordable Group Housing Colony] in Gurugram on 1-12-2015 under the scheme approved by the Government of Haryana [Affordable Housing Policy, 2013]. For the construction of Affordable Group Housing Colony, it was granted License No. 11 of 2014, dated 10-6-2014 by the Town & Country Planning Department, Haryana on the land measuring 5 acres located in the Revenue Estate of Village Dhankot, Sector 102, Gurugram. The building plan for construction of affordable flats was approved on 26-3-2015. The applicant started construction of flats before 31-3-2019 and the booking in respect of flats was also made in the pre-GST period.

The applicant further submitted an application to the Directorate of Town & Country Planning, Haryana on 3-2-2018 for the grant of license for setting up another Affordable Group Housing Colony over the land measuring 4 acres located in the Revenue Estate of Village Dhankot, Sector 102, Gurugram.

A separate license bearing No. 82 of 2018 for the construction of flats on the said land was granted by the Town & Country Planning Department on 6-12-2018. The building plan in respect of the said project was approved on 27-5-2019. On the basis of License No. 82 of 2018, the applicant was granted license bearing No. GGM/339/339/71/2019/33, dated 27-5-2019 by the Real Estate Regulation Authority (RERA) for construction of 595 flats in six towers.

The applicant sought advance ruling on the following question:

Whether the applicant is to pay tax at the rate of 6 per cent + 6 per cent (after availing land abatement = 4 per cent + 4 per cent) availing the input tax and as provided under Notification No. 11/2017 - Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017 and Notification No. 20/2017 - Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017 under Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 and Notification No. 46/ST2, dated 30-6-2017 and Notification No. 74/ST2, dated 22-8-2017 under Haryana Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017.

The applicant filed application alleging profiteering by the respondent in respect of purchase of a flat in the respondent's project 'Habitat-78'.

The applicant had alleged that the respondent had charged 12 per cent GST on the demand raised on 17-4-2018, i.e., after 25-1-2018, when the GST rate was reduced from 12 per cent to 8 per cent in case of affordable housing projects and also that the benefit of Input Tax Credit (ITC) had not been passed on to her by the respondent by way of commensurate reduction in price.

The DGAP submitted that based on the respondent's replies the project 'Habitat-78' was not in existence before the implementation of GST and was launched only in the GST regime and the agreement with the applicant was also executed on 17-11-2017. The DGAP on scrutiny of the documents (Home buyer's list and Agreement with the applicant dated 17-11-2017) submitted by the respondent, found that there was no price history of the units sold in the pre-GST era which could be compared with the post-GST base price to determine whether there was any profiteering or not. The Report also stated that the draw of lots, allotment of units and receipt of payments had taken place post-GST and the construction also commenced in January, 2018 and, therefore, there was no pre-GST tax rate of ITC which could be compared with the post-GST tax rate and ITC. The DGAP's Report also stated that the respondent must have taken into consideration the benefit of ITC available to him post implementation of GST, while fixing the base price. The Report had further claimed that the respondent had reduced the GST rate from 12 per cent to 8 per cent with effect from 25-1-2018, in terms of Notification No. 01/2018-Central Tax (Rate), dated 25-1-2018. Therefore, the DGAP in his report had concluded that the provisions of section 171 would not be attracted.

The applicant is engaged in works contract by way of construction, erection, commissioning, installation, completion, fitting out, repair, maintenance, renovation, or alteration.

The applicant is seeking Advance Ruling on questions as to what is rate of tax applicable to the composite supply of works contract as undertaken by the supplier (applicant) i.e., whether the GST rate 18 per cent or 12 per cent is to be charged by the supplier? and whether the amendment through Notification No. 20/2017 and 24/2017 to Notification No. 11/2017 - Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017 wherein the GST rate of 12 per cent (6 per cent CGST + 6 per cent SGST) has been notified in respect of works contract as defined in clause (119) of section 2 will be effective from the date of Notification No. 11/2017 and whether it would be in order for the applicant (supplier) to charge GST at the rate of 12 per cent (6 per cent CGST + 6 per cent SGST) or is the GST rate 18 per cent (9 per cent CGST + 9 per cent SGST) applicable to the nature of works contract undertaken by the applicant?

The applicant-firm of builders and developers is desirous to undertake an affordable housing project in Kolhapur. The land required for the project is already possessed by the firm. The units to be constructed in the said project will be of upto 30 sq. mtrs. (EWS) or upto 60 sq. mtrs. (LIG). It seeks advance ruling as to what is the rate of tax to be levied on the sale of Flats/Units to the prospective buyers? and whether full ITC is allowable or it will be restricted to out put GST liability?

The respondent was executing an affordable Housing Scheme approved by the Government of Haryana under the name and style of 'Arawali Homes'.

An application was filed before the Haryana State Screening Committee on Anti-Profiteering alleging profiteering by the respondent in respect of purchase of a flat in the respondent's project 'Arawali Homes'. The applicant had alleged that the respondent was collecting wrong GST post-implementation of GST and was not refunding GST collected in the wrong manner, even after sending clarification that the GST was not applicable to 'Affordable Housing', as the GST amount could be adjusted against the Input Tax Credit (ITC).

The DGAP noted that the ITC as a percentage of the turnover that was available to the respondent during the pre-GST period from April, 2016 to June, 2017 was 2.42 per cent and during the post-GST period from July, 2017 to August, 2018, it was 10.70 per cent which clearly established that post-GST, the respondent had benefited from additional ITC to the tune of 8.28 per cent [10.70 per cent (-) 2.42 per cent] of the taxable turnover. The effective GST rate on construction service in respect of the affordable and low-cost houses upto a carpet area of 60 square metres was further reduced from 12 per cent to 8 per cent, vide Notification No. 1/2018-Central Tax (Rate), dated 25-1-2018.

The applicant is providing works contract service as sub-contractor to main contractor for original contract work pertaining to railways. It executes and undertakes composite supply of works contract.

It sought advance ruling on the following questions:

1.

What tax rate to be charged by the applicant to main contractor on works contract services pertaining to railways original works contract.

2.

Whether to charge tax rate of 12 per cent GST or 18 per cent GST.

The Authority for Advance Rulings ruled that

-

The tax rate to be charged by the applicant to the main contractor would be at the rate of 6 per cent of CGST and 6 per cent of SGST.

-

The tax rate to be charged would be 12 per cent.

On appeal to Appellate Authority for Advance Ruling by revenue:

The appellant is having business of caterers and supplies food, beverages and other eatables (non-alcoholic drinks) complete services at various places of their customers, who have in house canteens of their factories.

The appellant submitted that it normally charges GST at the rate of 18 per cent classifying their services under heading 9963 as 'outdoor catering'.

The appellant submitted that one of the customers, who was recipient of services, had given the contract for catering services to be provided to the staff and premise for services to be provided for canteen, which was non air-conditioned, had also been made available to the appellant. The said customer had asked the appellant to charge GST at the rate of 12 per cent, therefore, the appellant requested for advance ruling as to whether rate of tax on their supplies made to the recipient would be 12 per cent or 18 per cent.

The Gujarat Authority for Advance Ruling ruled that the supply of services by appellant is covered under Sr. 7(v) of Notification No. 11/2017 - Central Tax (Rate) dated 28-6-2017, as amended, issued under the Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 and Notification No. 11/2017- Gujarat State Tax (Rate) dated 30-6-2017, as amended, issued under the Gujarat Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017, attracting Goods and Service Tax at the rate of 18 per cent (CGST 9 per cent +SGST 9 per cent.

The applicant is engaged in the business of Civil Construction and Works Contract Services. The applicant has applied for the civil construction work tender with Bangalore Development Authority (BDA) with respect to construction of residential complexes/row of residential houses.

The said project is allotted to the applicant and the same has been executed by the Company through appointing various contractors.

The applicant has sought advance ruling in respect of the question as to whether the activity undertaken by the applicant is covered under section 2(119); whether Bangalore Development Authority is a Government Authority as per the provisions of GST Law and the rate of tax applicable to the transaction of the applicant and more so whether the transactions are covered under entry 3(vi) of the Notification No. 11/2017 - Central Tax (Rate) dated 28-6-2017 (as amended).

According to applicant, its activity of construction of residential house and residential complex with respect to following BDA projects (to Government Authority) are squarely covered under the definition of Works Contract and their activity will be considered as supply of services.

The applicant submits that as per the Notification No. 11/2017 - Central Tax (Rate), the activity undertaken by the applicant to BDA i.e., Government Authority is liable for GST at 6 per cent CGST and 6 per cent SGST.

The applicant is a construction company engaged in the business of Mechanical, electrical and plumbing (MEP) turnkey project contracting & engineering. The MEP activities provided by the applicant include design, engineering, supply, installation and commissioning of plumbing, firefighting and electrical infrastructure systems to a wide range of commercial projects. The applicant is venturing into an agreement with a developer/builder to provide MEP services for an affordable housing project.

The applicant sought Advance Ruling on the following questions:

(1)

Whether MEP activities (Mechanical, Electrical & Plumbing Works) undertaken by the applicant falls within the definition of composite supply of works contract as defined under section 2(119) of CGST Act?

(2)

Whether can the applicant charge GST rate of 12 per cent on MEP (Mechanical, Electrical & Plumbing Works) activities by availing the benefit of Central Tax (Rate) Notification No 01/2018, dated 25-1-2018, if the said supplies are in relation to a housing project enjoying Infra status vide F No 13/6/2009-INF, dated 30-3-2017 of Government of India, in Ministry of Finance, Deptt, of Economic Affairs?

The applicant a proprietary concern entered into subcontract agreement with MEIL (Principal Contractor), for design, testing, commissioning of transmission of towers and was awarded subcontract works by the Principal Contractor on 12-10-2018, to execute the substation and terminal bay works.

The above said works were mainly awarded to the Principal Contractor by the state government entities such as Krishna Bhagya Jala Nigam Limited, Karnataka Neeravari Nigam Limited and Karnataka Power Transmission Corporation Limited. The said works have been awarded prior to GST but the same have been amended during the post-GST period.

The applicant has sought advance ruling in respect of the following question:

1.

What is rate of tax applicable to the composite supply of works contract as defined in clause (119) of Section 2 of Central Goods and Services Act, 2017 (The Act), undertaken by the supplier (applicant) i.e., whether the GST rate 18 per cent or 12 per cent is to be charged by the supplier?

2.

If the GST rate 18 per cent (9 per cent CGST+ 9 per cent SGST) as prescribed in serial No. 3, against heading No. 9954 (construction services), specified in Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017, is the rate applicable to the nature of works contract undertaken by the applicant, kindly clarify the following related aspects also:

The Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017, has been amended by:

i.

Notification No. 20/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 22-8-2017;

ii.

Notification No: 31/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 13-10-2017;

iii.

Notification No. 1/2018-Central Tax (Rate), dated 25-1-2018;

Wherein the GST rate of 12 per cent (6 per cent CGST + 6 per cent SGST) has been notified in respect of works contract as defined in clause (119) of section 2.

If so, whether it would be in order for the applicant (supplier) to charge GST at the rate of 12 per cent (6 per cent CGST+6 per cent SGST) or is the GST rate 18 per cent (9 per cent CGST+ 9 per cent SGST) applicable to the nature of works contract undertaken by the applicant?

The appellant is a supplier of works contract service and has entered into an agreement with IWAI, a statutory body established under the Inland Waterways Authority of India Act, 1985, for construction of a multi-modal IWT terminal at Haldia, West Bengal on EPC (Engineering, Procurement, Construction) basis.

The appellant sought an Advance Ruling on the question as to applicability of Notification No. 24/2017-CT (Rate), dated 21-9-2017 and 31/2017 Central tax (Rate), dated 13-10-2017 and what rate at which GST should be charged on the works contract service supplied for construction of a multi-modal terminal at Haldia, West Bengal.

The West Bengal Authority for Advance Ruling held that amendments to Serial No. 3(vi) of Notification No. 11/2017 Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017 brought about by Notification No. 24/2017 Central Tax (Rate), dated 21-9-2017 and 31/2017 Central Tax (Rate), dated 13-10-2017, are not applicable to the applicant's supply of works contract service for construction of the Multi-modal IWT Terminal at Haldia. It will attract GST at 18 per cent rate under Serial No. 3(xii) of Notification No. 11/2017 Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017.

The appellant has filed the instant appeal against the Advance Ruling with the prayer to set aside the impugned Advance Ruling passed by the WBAAR on the grounds that IWAI, is a Government Entity and hence the supply of service by the appellant is taxable at the rate of 12 per cent under the GST Act in terms of Serial No. 3(vi) of the Rate Notification as amended.

The applicant (M.P. Power Generating Co. Ltd.) is 100 per cent Madhya Pradesh State Government hold company.

The State Government of Madhya Pradesh awarded a contract to the applicant to construct a Thermal Power Project.

Further the applicant has awarded a contract to one Shreeji Infrastructure India (P.) Ltd. towards construction of certain residential quarters at aforesaid Thermal Power Project.

It sought advance ruling on the following questions:

-

Rate of GST on contract for construction of building and structure for colony at Thermal Power Project as per Notification No. 11/2017 as amended by Notification No. 24/2017 and further amended vide Notification No. 31/2017.

-

Rate of GST on construction contract of residential quarters at various power houses of the applicant as per Notification No. 11/2017 as amended by Notification No. 24/2017 and further amended vide Notification No. 31/2017.

The applicant submitted before the Authority for Advance Ruling that Shreeji Infrastructure India (P.) Ltd. has obtained an advance ruling on the issue raised in the instant application vide order No. 15/2018, dated 18-10-2018, but this fact was not brought to the notice of the Authority that the work is being entrusted to the applicant by Government of Madhya Pradesh and hence the applicant is filing a fresh advance ruling application.

The applicant was engaged in providing works contract service as sub-contract to main contractor for original contract work pertaining to railways. The assessee filed instant application to sought clarification for rate of tax to be levied by it to main contractor for original contract work pertaining to railways. The assessee submitted that it should be charged 12 per cent GST only and not 18 per cent as applicable in other cases.

The applicant has been awarded a contract by one Rites Limited, which is a Public Sector Undertaking. Said contract is awarded for execution of works of laying of track as per layout plan, pavement along the track, construction of Admin building, Warehouse, Electrical works and Fire-fighting works, etc. at Khodiyar Gandhinagar, Gujarat. Further contract is involving both supply of goods and services and is a composite supply in the nature of works contract supply.

The applicant sought advance ruling in respect of the following question:

Whether the said work can be covered under clause 3(v)(a) of the Notification No. 11/2017 - Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017, i.e., works contract by way of construction, erection, commissioning or installation of original works pertaining to railways so as the entitle it for charging rate of GST at the rate of 12 per cent instead of 18 per cent.

The applicant, engaged in business of construction of residential and commercial complex, is developing residential project called 'SAMANVAY RESIDENCY'.

The applicant seeks advance ruling on issue as to whether the construction services provided by the applicant under the project 'SAMANVAY RESIDENCY' qualifies for the reduced CGST rate of 6 per cent (under CGST and SGST Act) as provided in Sl. No. 3 item (v) sub-item (da) of Notification No. 01/2018-CT (Rate), dated 25-1-2018.

The appellant is engaged in providing electrification work to APEPDCL, a State Government entity for procurement of plan, design, supply, install and commission certain facilities viz., providing underground cable work with underground power cable network on turnkey basis.

The appellant had filed an application for Advance Ruling raising following questions.

(1) Whether the tax rate of 12 per cent (CGST-6 per cent + SGST-6 per cent) is applicable to contract, in pursuance of Notification No. 20/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 22-8-2017 and No. 24/2017 - Central Tax (Rate), dated 21-9-2017.
